failure_summary.description: A ready restaurant search or an earlier requested hotel search was omitted while handling another part of the request.
A search was duplicated or left unassigned, or its result was not saved to cache.
A state abbreviation was incorrectly passed as a city.
Generated code included imports or extraneous status output.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly covers independent handling of requested domains, pending follow-ups, state-versus-city mapping, assigned-and-saved result calls, avoiding duplicates, and not importing helper libraries. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing rules rather than an uncovered gap; repeating them has also been ineffective, so no edit is warranted.
